thread:
ana: Heads-up — ACME just asked to push tenant SSO into MVP. They said it's blocking their pilot. Meeting w/ customer in 2pm. Need quick tradeoff call, cc @sam @liz
sam: Do we have UX/engineering estimate? rough ballpark?
liz: 3-4 sprints to do full SAML + admin UI. Could we do passwordless+SCIM-lite for MVP instead?
ana: From convo: they'll accept OIDC only if users can SSO via their IdP, pilot target is ~6 weeks. If we can't support, they delay pilot.
marco: Feasibility check: we can ship an OIDC bridge (login redirect + session mapping) without SCIM in ~2 weeks if we scope down: no provisioning, no admin UI. Need e2e tests + infra certs.
sam: That sounds promising. What's the main risk?
marco: Account-linking for existing users is the trickiest bit. Also telemetry gaps on auth failures and edge-case UX with duplicate emails. Rollback surface is moderate.
olivia: QA: integration matrix + support runbook will add ~3 days. Also need a feature flag + kill-switch for canary.
ana: Proposed compromise: include OIDC-only login behind a feature flag in MVP, push SCIM/provisioning and admin UX to v1. Update launch criteria to require runbook and canary plan.
liz: Works for pilot customers but need explicit customer comms: they'll accept a narrower MVP if we state known limitations clearly. Support SLA needs to be agreed (they okay with lower SLA for pilot).
sam: Agree. Add rollback/stop criteria: >2% auth errors OR any >1h outage => rollback.
ana: Quick plan snippet:
```
MVP SSO slice:
- OIDC provider login (redirect) [MVP behind flag]
- No SCIM/provisioning (defer to v1)
- Admin UI disabled for MVP
- Rollout: canary (5 tenants) -> ramp -> full
- QA gating: integration tests + smoke on canaries
- Rollback criteria: >2% auth errors or >1h incident
```
marco: I'll open the infra/config PR for feature flag + OIDC bridge. ETA: EOW.
olivia: I'll schedule QA integration tests for Tue sprint and add smoke jobs.
ana: Also cutting scope: move payments webhooks polish out of this release to keep runway.
liz: I'll draft the customer note with explicit limitations and set expectation for v1 timeline.
sam: reminder to update milestone board and the launch checklist (token counts, perf tests).
deploy-bot: Build pipeline scheduled for branch feature/sso-oidc at 18:42 UTC :white_check_mark:
ana: Thanks — decision made: ship OIDC-only behind flag in MVP for ACME pilot; SCIM/admin in v1. Filing follow-ups and updating milestones. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
